name: v2.3.2
body:
## What's Changed
* Fix SEO issues: lengthen compute overview description by @mintlify[bot] in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1935
* fix(openapi): document dual 404 content types for function invoke ope… by @bowale01 in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1928
* fix(dashboard): correct false-positive limited flag on CSV export by @thegoodengineer in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1885
* fix: PROJECT_ID is not a cloud signal; one cloud predicate and one cloud signer by @Fermionic-Lyu in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1942
* fix(dashboard): include latest disk reading in chart by @Gautam-aman in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1923
* fix(ai): load .env.local in Quick Start scripts by @ssrajadh in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1927
* fix(functions): reject reserved function slugs instead of silently shadowing them by @shashank-100 in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1936
* fix(storage): align list response schema by @dongyikuan919 in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1957
* docs: agents-only pointer to agents.insforge.dev on introduction page by @tonychang04 in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1971
* Fix SEO issues: descriptive titles on introduction pages by @mintlify[bot] in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1972
* feat(ui): add Popover, Calendar and ClockColumn by @CarmenDou in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1976
* docs(compute): replace DockerProvider's orphaned isCloudManaged docblock by @sanidhyasin in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1958
* fix(functions): hide generated route inventories by @iPLAYCAFE-dev in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1961
* fix(s3-gateway): correct ListObjectsV2 truncation and continuation semantics by @thegoodengineer in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1960
* fix(deps): bump vulnerable dependencies flagged by Vanta by @jwfing in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1992
* fix(openapi): add cloud Subhosting 404 variant to function invoke spec by @bowale01 in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1980
* fix(advisor): resolve RLS policy columns from pg_depend, not a regex by @thegoodengineer in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1985
* fix(advisor): recommend FK index columns in constraint order by @thegoodengineer in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1983
* fix(deps): clear 3 of 5 Dependabot vulnerabilities (lockfile-only) by @tonychang04 in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1993
* fix(deps): bump dompurify override to 3.4.14, clearing the last audit finding by @tonychang04 in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/2008
* fix(memory): set embedding_model when the reconcile path re-embeds by @ssrajadh in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1994
* docs(openapi): make logs.yaml match the routes the logs router mounts by @thegoodengineer in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1997
* Fix grammar & typos: clean up whitespace in logs.yaml by @mintlify[bot] in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/2011
* Enforce your style guide: verb-first summaries in logs.yaml by @mintlify[bot] in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/2010
* fix(dashboard): keep row hover background opaque in data grid by @vraj00222 in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/2006
* docs: add RepoCloud one-click deploy button by @cosark in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/2014
* docs(openapi): rename metadata.yaml's nextAction to the nextActions the server sends by @ayaangazali in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/2013
* Fix grammar & typos: README punctuation and hyphenation by @mintlify[bot] in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/2019
* fix(ai): prevent token double-counting in streaming responses by @sankar-chaitanya2025 in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/2016
* 2026-08-16 fix mintlify docs by @insforge-docs-bot[bot] in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1968
* fix(ui): Skeleton shimmers in a tone that reads on both themes by @Fermionic-Lyu in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/2037
* fix(auth): require a cloud-signed identity on shared OAuth callbacks by @Fermionic-Lyu in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/2051
* Bump version to 2.3.2 by @agent-zhang-beihai[bot] in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/2052

## New Contributors
* @thegoodengineer made their first contribution in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1885
* @shashank-100 made their first contribution in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1936
* @dongyikuan919 made their first contribution in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1957
* @sanidhyasin made their first contribution in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1958
* @iPLAYCAFE-dev made their first contribution in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1961
* @vraj00222 made their first contribution in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/2006
* @cosark made their first contribution in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/2014
* @sankar-chaitanya2025 made their first contribution in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/2016

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/compare/v2.3.1...v2.3.2
